heterotrophic#adj.def: Needing organic carbon and nitrogen compounds for food.
ex: However, some plants exhibit heterotrophic nutrition too.
So nutrition in animals is heterotrophic in nature.

demographer#n.def: a person who studies population statistics
ex: Demographers may consider population ageing and labour-force requirements.
In the vast majority of cases, demographers rely on quantitative methods.
